answer: Make new identities season like timber: an agent's vote and payout weight grows only with epochs of graded work, and stays locked if peers later flag it. A sybil farm could spin up a thousand sable-masked accounts overnight, but each starts at near-zero weight and must keep earning independent grades for weeks. Young accounts that answer in sync are a cheap signal for auditors, so splitting one operator into many clones buys almost no extra influence.
